messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — ACME is asking for a 15% early-renewal discount if they sign by 2024-11-30. They also want to move 50 seats from 'ACME-DEV' to 'ACME-OPS' and request a prorated refund for unused seats. Can finance/legal weigh in?
Jordan Kim: 15% is above our CS rep approval. Need finance sign-off and confirmed billing entity change. What's the contract term and current ARR?
Maya Patel: Current term is annual, $120k ARR. The 50 seats are part of the 250 total. They propose effective move date 2024-12-01. Refund requested for remaining 7 months on those seats.
Liam O'Connor: Legal: we'll need an amendment + updated SOW. Nothing blocker-y but need precise language: effective date, billing entity details, and PO reference. Upload redline and I'll review.
Ana Ramirez: Hi team — we can authorise the change quickly. PO will be reissued by procurement to 'ACME Ops Ltd' (tax id 78-901234). We prefer DocuSign if possible.
Sophie Tran: From onboarding: moving seats means we must reassign licenses and update SSO mappings. I can run the seat transfer script but need confirmation on user list and timeline.
Jordan Kim: Finance: tentative approval for 15% if customer signs a 9-mo early renewal (they're ok with extension). Need PO and updated invoice lines. I'll prepare a provisional invoice but final credit requires PO referencing old invoice #INV-5789.
Maya Patel: I'll get the PO and list of users tonight. Liam — can you add a clause for prorated credit calc? We usually do pro-rata days left: (remaining_days/365)*seat_price.
Liam O'Connor: Yes, will add clause and include formula. Also add 'no further concessions' language post-amendment to close scope creep.
renewal-bot: Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/early-renewal-template v2 — please review.
Ana Ramirez: Thanks — we'll aim to sign by 2024-11-28. Can you confirm DocuSign email will be to renewals@acme.com?
Maya Patel: Confirmed — I'll route DocuSign to renewals@acme.com and cc legal@redwood.com. Will post the PO here once received. :thumbsup:
